newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA CRISIL ASSIGNS AA-(SO) RATING TO VIDC.
newsitem.headline: INDIA CRISIL ASSIGNS AA-(SO) RATING TO VIDC.

text.p: The Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said it had assigned an "AA-(so)" rating to the bond issue of the Vidarbha Irrigation Development Corporation (VIDC), indicating high safety for timely payment of interest and principal.

Repayment obligations on the debentures are supported by the Government of Maharashtra (GoM) through a tripartite agreement between VIDC, GoM and the trustees to the issue, CRISIL said in a statement on Wednesday.

VIDC was incorporated on March 31, 1997 to implement various irrigation schemes in the Vidarbha region of Maharashtra. GoM is required to provide an aggregate sum of not less than 13 billion rupees through budgetary allocations to the Corporation Fund as its share of VIDC capital, CRISIL said.

Since VIDC is not expected to service the interest and principal repayments on the debentures, the primary support for servicing the debentures will be provided by the GoM, through the tripartite agreement. Therefore, the rating reflects the ability of the GoM to service this debt, CRISIL added.
